epgSource.title: EPG Source
epgSource.description:
PMS:
- Use EPG data from Plex or Emby
- Relies on Plex/Emby's own guide database, which mainly covers US/Canada broadcast TV
- International channels (Sky Sports, Australian sports, etc.) and 24/7 loop channels usually get no guide data this way

XEPG (recommended for anything outside the US/Canada):
- Use of one or more XMLTV files - point it at a guide source that actually covers your channels
- Channel management
- M3U / XMLTV export (HTTP link for IPTV apps)
- Channels with no real schedule can use the built-in 'xTeVe Dummy' placeholder guide instead of showing nothing

tuner.title: Number of Tuners
tuner.description:
Number of parallel connections that can be established to the provider.
Available for: Plex, Emby (HDHR), M3U (with active buffer).
After changing it, remove xTeVe Reborn from Plex / Emby / Jellyfin Live TV and add it again.

filesUpdate.title: Updates all files at startup
filesUpdate.description: Updates all playlists, tuner and XMLTV files at startup.

cacheImages.title: Image Caching
cacheImages.description:
All images from the XMLTV file are cached, allowing faster rendering of the grid in the client.
Downloading the images may take a while and will be done in the background.

replaceEmptyImages.title: Replace missing program images
replaceEmptyImages.description: If the poster in the XMLTV program is missing, the channel logo will be used.

sourceCheckInterval.title: Check sources for changes every (minutes)
sourceCheckInterval.description: Between the scheduled updates above, each playlist and XMLTV source is checked this often, and the guide is rebuilt only if a source's content actually changed. A check that finds nothing new is one small request per source (servers that support ETag / Last-Modified answer without resending the file). Set to 0 to turn off. Minimum 5.

plexChannelLimit.title: Plex channel limit
plexChannelLimit.description: How many active channels xTeVe Reborn expects Plex to accept. Plex gets unreliable well before 1000 channels, so leave this at 480 unless you do not use Plex. Warnings appear when the number of active channels goes above it; nothing is blocked.

unfilteredChannelLimit.title: Unfiltered channel limit
unfilteredChannelLimit.description: How many streams may be active automatically while no filter is configured. Above this, nothing is activated until you add a filter, which is why a large Jellyfin or Emby lineup can look empty: raise this (or add a filter) to activate it all at once.

unsaved.confirmLeave: You have unsaved settings. Discard them?

xteveAutoUpdate.title: Automatically install updates
xteveAutoUpdate.description: Checks GitHub for a newer release once a day (and at startup) regardless of this setting. When on, a newer release is downloaded and installed automatically, restarting the server. When off (default), you'll just see an Update available notice and install it yourself with the button below.

streamBuffering.title: Stream Buffer
streamBuffering.description:
Functions of the buffer:
- The stream is passed from xTeVe Reborn, FFmpeg or VLC to Plex, Emby or M3U Player
- Small jerking of the streams can be compensated
- HLS / M3U8 support
- RTP / RTPS support (only FFmpeg or VLC)
- Re-streaming
- Separate tuner limit for each playlist
streamBuffering.info_false: No Buffer (Client connects to the streaming server)
streamBuffering.info_xteve: xTeVe Reborn connects to the streaming server
streamBuffering.info_ffmpeg: FFmpeg connects to the streaming server
streamBuffering.info_vlc: VLC connects to the streaming server

udpxy.title: UDPxy address
udpxy.description: The address of your UDPxy server. If set, and the channel URLs in the m3u is multicast, xTeVe Reborn will rewrite it so that it is accessed via the UDPxy service.

bufferSize.title: Buffer Size
bufferSize.description:
Buffer size in MB.
M3U8: If the TS segment smaller then the buffer size, the file size of the segment is used.

bufferTimeout.title: Timeout for new client connections
bufferTimeout.description: The xTeVe Reborn buffer waits until new client connections are established. Helpful for fast channel switching. Value in milliseconds.

userAgent.title: User Agent
userAgent.description: User Agent for HTTP requests. For every HTTP connection, this value is used for the user agent. Should only be changed if xTeVe Reborn is blocked.

backupPath.title: Location for automatic backups
backupPath.description: Before any update of the provider data by the schedule, xTeVe Reborn creates a backup. The path for the automatic backups can be changed. xTeVe Reborn requires write permission for this folder.

backupKeep.title: Number of backups to keep
backupKeep.description: Number of backups to keep. Older backups are automatically deleted.

webAuth.title: Protect this web interface
webAuth.description:
Without a login, anyone on your network can open this page and change your setup. The Log page also shows your provider's stream URLs, which usually contain your account username and password.

If you choose Yes, you'll create a username and password as soon as setup finishes.

finish.title: Add to Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin
finish.description: This is the only address you need - copy it into your media server's Live TV & DVR setup.
finish.plexSteps: Plex: Settings → Live TV & DVR → Set Up Plex DVR. Plex usually finds it automatically within a few seconds. If it doesn't, choose 'Don't see your HDHomeRun tuner?' and paste the address above.
finish.embySteps: Emby or Jellyfin: Live TV → Add Tuner Device → HDHomeRun, then paste the same address.
